draft.body: Auri isn't just a gold app — it's an API. The same engine that buys, borrows, and moves allocated gold runs behind scoped keys, so a fintech can offer gold without building a vault or a lending market. Session-secured: a leaked key can't exceed caps or move funds out. Live in private beta.
